output.summary: A legume-family plant found across much of the Iberian Peninsula, southwestern France and northern Morocco, although its native origin is not explicitly stated. It grows characteristically in low scrub on acidic ground, and its March-to-June flowers are used in cooking, including carqueja rice.
output.edibilityNote: The flowers are used in cooking, including carqueja rice, and are also prepared as medicinal infusions.
